title: overview / Choose where to start
content:
## Choose where to start If you're new to both {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %} and AI, first [install the editor and open a workspace](/docs/getstarted/overview.md). Otherwise, choose a sample project to learn with, or apply an agent workflow to your own repository:

Complete your first agent task

Recommended starting point. Build and validate a small web app, then review the changes.

Sample project. No runtime or build tools required.

Start in the {% data variables.copilot.agents_window %}, continue in the editor

Build a portfolio page, then continue the same session alongside your code to refine, test, and review it.

Sample project. Requires Git.

Work in your own repository

Already use agents? Follow the fast track to explore your codebase or add a feature.

Use your own repository. Check the requirements for the guide you choose.
To work beyond your development machine, [start a task in a cloud session and continue it from a terminal with {% data variables.copilot.copilot_cli_short %}](/docs/agents/cloud-continuity-tutorial.md) `feature(cloud-sessions)`. Use your own private repository without cloning it or installing project dependencies. Requires cloud session access and {% data variables.copilot.copilot_cli_short %}. Or jump to a task: * [Work on a project](#work-on-a-project). * [Test and validate](#test-and-validate). * [Customize and coordinate agents](#customize-and-coordinate-agents). * [Improve results and recover](#improve-results-and-recover).
